subject: Mutual action plan draft — Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery for Novarisk
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novarisk.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novarisk.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan draft — Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery for Novarisk

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great talking earlier — thanks for the time. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures the milestones we discussed, with a focus on the security review / SOC 2 package delivery line items. High-level recap below and a proposed timeline:

Summary of discussion:
- Novarisk needs confirmation of Redwood's SOC 2 scope + evidence to satisfy internal audit.
- Key deliverable for your team: complete the SOC 2 questionnaire and confirm the list of evidence you need from us.
- Redwood will assemble an evidence bundle (controls narrative, policy docs, architecture diagram, SOC 2 report excerpt, access logs sample) and will coordinate secure transfer.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Jan 19: Novarisk completes SOC 2 questionnaire (owner: Novarisk - Alex)
2) Jan 26: Redwood delivers initial evidence index + samples (owner: Redwood - Monica)
3) Feb 2: Secure transfer of full evidence package (owner: Redwood - Monica / Hannah)
4) Feb 28: Target procurement close (mutual)

Dependencies / open items:
- Please confirm whether you need full log history or samples for each control area.
- Preferred secure transfer method (SFTP, SharePoint, or secure Google Drive).
- Any internal stakeholder beyond Priya who should be on the MAP.

Next steps: Please review the attached MAP (Novarisk_MAP_v1.docx) and confirm the questionnaire due date. If Jan 19 is tight, propose an alternate date and we will adjust milestone 2 accordingly.

Attachments: Novarisk_MAP_v1.docx (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Rishi
--
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Thanks Rishi — good recap. Quick notes: 

- Jan 19 is a little aggressive for us given internal calendar freezes next week. Can we move the SOC 2 questionnaire completion to Jan 22?
- We need a clearer breakdown of what "evidence bundle" includes. Can you add a per-control list (policy, logs, access rosters, test results)?
- Also: will Redwood redact PII from logs or provide sampling guidance?

I attached a short prelim list of our questions to make it easier to map responsibilities.

Team — forwarding Novarisk's reply. They're asking to shift the questionnaire to Jan 22 and want per-control evidence breakdown + guidance on log sampling / redaction. Can we commit to the adjusted plan? Proposed internal owners below: 

- Monica: evidence index + transfer method (deliverable Jan 26)
- Hannah: redaction guidance / evidence sample generation (deliverable Feb 2)
- Marcus: architecture diagram + ops controls narrative (deliverable Jan 26)

Monica / Hannah / Marcus — please confirm you can hit these deliverables if we move questionnaire due date to Jan 22. If any blockers, flag them here and I'll escalate with Novarisk.

Thanks,
Rishi

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft — Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery for Novarisk

Alex / Priya — thanks for the note. Confirming we can move questionnaire completion to Jan 22 and will aim to deliver the evidence index by Jan 26. Attached is a preliminary evidence index (CSV) mapping control families to example artifacts + suggested sample sizes.

Quick questions for your team:
- Preferred transfer: SFTP or secure Google Drive link? We can also use an encrypted SharePoint container.
- For logs: do you require full retention extracts or 30-day samples per control?

Attachments: evidence-index.csv (preview)

I'll draft the per-control checklist and share the redaction guidance from Hannah by Monday.

Best,
Monica Patel

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novarisk.com>

Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novarisk.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft — Security review & SOC 2 evidence delivery for Novarisk

Thanks Monica — that works. Novarisk confirms:
- Questionnaire completion by Jan 22 (owner: Alex)
- We'll accept a 30-day sampled log set for initial review; we may request fuller extracts later in procurement.
- Preferred transfer: secure Google Drive link (with restricted access) — please share once ready.

Redwood deliverables (as agreed):
- Jan 26: Evidence index + architecture diagram (Monica / Marcus)
- Feb 2: Full evidence package (samples/redacted logs) delivered via secure Drive (Monica / Hannah)
- Feb 28: Target procurement close — Novarisk procurement will aim for this date, pending final evidence review and legal review.

If Redwood can also provide a short controls narrative PDF and a guide to redaction templates, that would speed internal sign-off. Once you share the Drive link, I'll circulate to our audit team.

DocuSign / procurement note: I'm looping Priya — she will coordinate contract steps once the evidence package is received.

Thanks all — confirm back and we'll lock dates into the MAP.

Regards,
Alex Turner
Security Lead | Novarisk
